tools.description: Compare two saved versions, the same as Compare in the studio Versions panel. Returns each changed file (path, oldPath for a rename, status added, removed, modified or renamed, additions, deletions, binary) with its unified git diff (cut at 64 KB a file, 512 KB in all, and 100 files; truncated says so). With thumbnails (default) it also returns thumbs: absolute PNG paths of a 1280x800 screenshot of each version, a mask PNG of the changed pixels and changedPct. Read only.

directionId.description: Direction id. Leave out for the main direction.

from.description: The older version id, from list_versions.

thumbnails.description: Render a screenshot of both versions and a changed-pixel mask, and return their file paths. Default true.

to.description: The newer version id. Leave out for the head version of the direction.

tools.name: diff_versions

tools.description: Make an older version the current design of a direction. Saved as a new version that undo takes back. The current prototype links and canvas frames stay; only the page files change.

directionId.description: Direction id. Use the main direction id for the main one.

tools.name: restore_version
